subject: humanities
passage: For centuries, owning a portrait meant paying a painter for many hours of work, so portraits were mostly a luxury of the wealthy. By the 1850s, however, a photographic portrait cost far less than a painted one and could be completed in a single short sitting. ______ many working- and middle-class families who had never been able to afford a painting of a relative could now own pictures of their loved ones.
stem: Which choice completes the text with the most logical transition?

explanation.why: The second sentence explains that photographic portraits were cheap and quick. The last sentence describes what followed from this: families who could not afford paintings could now own portraits. A cause-and-effect transition is needed.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Nevertheless" signals that something happens despite an obstacle, but cheap photographs made owning portraits easier, not harder.
explanation.B: Correct. "Consequently" shows that more families could own portraits because photographic portraits were cheap and fast to make.
explanation.C: Incorrect. Although the families differ from the wealthy mentioned earlier, the last sentence follows from the low cost of photographs in the sentence just before it; it does not contrast with it.
explanation.D: Incorrect. Families owning photographs is not an instance of photographs being cheap and quick; it is the result.
